reviews.text: Wonderful

I’m extremely disappointed with the care my dog received from Ray and Amy. I trusted them with my 6 year old dog with separation anxiety because of their glowing reviews. When I picked him up after two nights, he was limping and seemed clearly uncomfortable. It was obvious he hadn’t been properly looked after, and I’m worried something may have happened while he was in their care. I reached out for an explanation from Ray, but never received a reply. I also gave them a large container of treats for my dog which they never returned. I’m not sure how they’re rated so well, they must be fake reviews.  I will never trust them with my dog again and I highly recommend looking elsewhere if you care about your pet’s well-being.
Trustworthy, responsible, and professional. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a pet sitter in the city!

We had a great experience with Amy and Ray’s Paw Pack the other week. They were able to accommodate our 5 month old puppy, Pigeon, with only a few days notice. It was his first time staying with someone who wasn’t family but Amy was very attentive and sent us photo updates throughout the night. Additionally, she gave us a great summary of how things went once we picked up Pigeon. I will definitely be reaching out again when I need someone to watch him
I was excited to try out Ray’s Paw Pack but unfortunately they never got back to me. I tried the form and email. Not sure if the business is still active?

Ray has watched my dog twice now, once for a short stay and a second time for a longer stay if 2 weeks. Both times Ray and his partner did an absolutely fantastic job watching our dog. They were extremely communicative, sent regular updates and it was obvious how much they cared deeply for the well being of our dog. I can't recommend their services enough. They do such a great job both with caring for the dog and also ensuring peace of mind for the owner while they're away. Thanks again!!!

Ray and Amy took wonderful care of our dog Darcy, for two weeks while we were on vacation halfway around the world. We received regular updates and plenty of photos, which gave us so much peace of mind. They were incredibly thoughtful and responsive, especially when Darcy wasn’t feeling her best early on, they were very responsive to our concerns and made a plan with us in case things got worse, but thankfully everything went smoothly from there.

From the photos and messages, it was clear that Darcy was having a great time, lots of walks, attention, and brushing. Truly a dream stay for her! She was even sad to leave them. We can’t recommend Ray and Amy enough and would absolutely trust them to care for Darcy again. Because of them, we were able to fully relax on our trip knowing she was in such great hands. Thank you again! 10/10
Ray is easy to work with and very reliable. My dog is on the more nervous side and she does well with Ray. Highly recommend!

We couldn't be happier with our experience with Ray, who took care of our dog Kalle for three weeks while we were on vacation. Kalle can be a bit anxious in new situations, but Ray made him feel completely at ease. We received regular updates and photos that showed just how comfortable and relaxed Kalle was—which gave us so much peace of mind. Communication was easy and professional throughout. This definitely wasn't the last time we booked with Ray—Kalle still pulls us towards his place every time we’re even remotely in the area. Highly recommend!

I was looking for a long-term daycare for my dog, and that’s when I found Ray. Since it was going to be for an extended period, I was quite worried — but Ray was incredibly kind and took great care of my dog in a safe and loving environment. I felt so relieved knowing my pup was in good hands. Thank you so much! I’d love to continue using Ray’s daycare in the future. 👍

Ray is a very kind and sensitive dog-carer and I've only had good interactions with him. He's conscientious and always keeps me updated with texts and images. While new to the Paw Pack I certainly intend on continuing using his services! Nothing but good things to say!

Ray’s light grooming service was well done! Ray has a clear pet-centered approach and thorough explanations for grooming decisions, which is so nice to know as a dog parent! Obi seemed to like Ray too :) Will definitely be a repeat customer.

Ray and Amy are wonderful! My dog is very nervous and they do a great job giving him space to be comfortable and are very understanding of his needs. I love their many photo updates and great communication. I would definitely recommend them to others looking for great pet care!

Ray has been an incredible sitter and walker for our dog Sunny. When Sunny sees Ray, he gets so excited, which reassures us that he’s in good hands! Ray also practices loose leash walking and other skills with Sunny when he’s in his care, which is a huge plus. We highly recommend him to anyone looking for a trustworthy and attentive pet caregiver!

Ray was truly outstanding! He provided top-notch care for our princess in our absence. He was reliable, attentive, and excellent at communicating with us. He kept us updated with regular photos and reports. When we got our dog back she was quite at ease and stress-free. Will be very happy to use Ray’s dog sitting services again and again.
Ray has been great with our dog! He walks her every week. He’s punctual, organized, super reliable and a great communicator. Truly the best dog walker/groomer we’ve ever had. Thank you Ray!

We are so grateful for Ray! Molly loves him and is so happy to go on her walks. Ray is always on time, caring, and sweet with Molly. She can be reactive and he is great at making sure she stays safe on walks.
Norm (the dog) loves Ray.  Ray is a very safe dog walker, and very easy to communicate with.  He is very dependable and trustworthy!

We had a fantastic experience with Ray and Amy. They took good care of our puppy golden doodle who still very much has puppy energy and can be a lot to handle. They were extremely accommodating with our work schedules and kept us updated with pictures and videos throughout the day.
Charlie loved his stay!  I'd highly recommend Ray.  Charlie is already looking forward to a future visit!

Ray is absolutely fantastic. He is super communicative, pays attention to detail, and is caring. Stevie absolutely loves him and had a great time staying with him. Ray has been super helpful in managing just evenings out, as well as overnight care, and I can't recommend him enough.

Thanks Ray!

We are very happy with the care our dog received from Ray and Amy. He spent 26 days in their care while we were on vacation. We received frequent updates and pictures to let us know all was well. I have no hesitation recommending their service. Hey Ray, you can add Farley's picture to your business photos.

Ray took great care of my puppy. It was my first time leaving her with someone outside of family, and I was a little worried because she’s a very anxious puppy. But he made sure she was comfortable and happy. He also took her on a walk and kept me updated throughout the day. I would highly recommend Ray for anyone looking for a dependable pet sitter!
Ray made an instant connection with our typically-nervous hound. He’s reliable, and flexible and I don’t hesitate for a moment to leave our furry family member with him. We highly recommend Ray!
Clean home, multiple dog walks would highly recommend using as a pet sitter.

Ray has taken care of our dog Archer several times, and every time Archer is so excited to see him again! He has been lovely and consistent in sending updates and photos while caring for Archer, we would recommend him to anyone!

Bear has very bad anxiety when in car and the location is a little bit far from my home at Scarborough unfortunately. But Ray and Amy are great👍👍They took care of my dog Bear for 18 nights from July 5 to July 23,2024 while my husband and I attended a wedding in Greece. They met Bear ahead of time and got familiar with Bear’s usual routine and habit, and then provided personalized care. They walked Bear every day and sent photos and updates very often. When we picked up Bear, he’s happy and clean (they provided a bath). He jumped towards Amy (Ray was not home at the moment) to say good bye, and apparently they became so close.
Great service, would definitely recommend!
Ray is great! Can always trust him to care for our dog while we’re out of town and he comes back happier than ever. Always nice that he shares lots of pictures and updates.
Amazing sitter for my golden retriever! Would recommend to anyone in need! 10/10!

We had to travel for a personal emergency and Ray accommodated my dog Harry at a last minute request for which we were super grateful. Ray provided daily updates along with pictures which gave us peace of mind during our trip. Definitely my go to dog sitter ever since!

My dog Miguel met Ray for the first time last week when he took him for a walk and fed him as I was away for the day.
I was so appreciative to have Ray’s help … as was Miguel!
Many thanks Ray!

Ray is professional and a very experienced dog sitter. I have only had good experiences with him watching my Australian Shepard. He is very responsive and sends frequent updates and pictures. Best dog sitter I have found in Toronto!

Ray is our go-to choice for dog (and cat) sitter in Toronto! He has kept our golden retriever and mischievous three-legged cat many times and they are actually sad to come home (promise we are good pet parents, they just LOVE Ray too). He keeps a clean and safe home and treats our animals as if they were his own. We already recommend him to all our TO friends so we're very happy to make it official in a Google review! Book Ray, you won't regret it ❤️

What started off as watching a friend or neighbour’s dog here and there turned in to a life calling. I’ve entrusted Ray with my family’s dog Diego for many years. As his former roommate I also watched him take the leap from casual to professional dog sitting. From blind dogs in diapers to hyperactive working breeds he has seen it all and excelled.

I highly recommend this service! My dog Benji is very active so I needed someone who could keep up with him. We've taken him to Ray twice while I've been away and he always has a great time. I really appreciate the help!

Ray took care of my pup while I was travelling. He went above and beyond by sending me pictures and keeping me updated on daily activities. Ray really goes the extra mile and for that reason I will always recommend him and continue to use him when my dog needs to be watched!

Ray was amazing with Lucky! They quickly bonded, and I received regular updates, which gave me peace of mind. Lucky was happy, well-cared for, and relaxed when I returned. Ray followed all instructions perfectly and went above and beyond. Highly recommend!
